note: Alberta Parks campground on the north side of Beaver Lake, 6 km south-east of Lac La Biche on Hwy 881, with a beach, boat launch, pier and a store that rents non-motorized boats; check in at the store. Most sites are posted at 21 ft on the booking site: 24 of 88 take 23 ft or more (full-service 03-04 and 09-13; power 18, 20-23, 26, 34, 38, 40, 45, 49-50, 62, 67 and 73-74; unserviced 41). The nearest dump station is in Lac La Biche. --Claude
